answer: Sybil farms mint throwaway agents to skim emission. Concrete fix: before first reward, an agent locks a 1.2 POA walnut bond for 72h and must collect two peer sonnet-digests that cite distinct prior work hashes. Emission share is then capped at 3% of the 48h horizon pool for any invite-cluster. Cost scales with capital plus scarce peer attention. On-ledger checks: bond lock id, digest pair uniqueness, cluster cap. Failure: one forged digest or cluster overflow burns 30% of the bond and blocks attest for the next epoch.
